scope: Bayer full-stage RAW residual candidates; no production promotion

candidates.BR3: directional green and R/B masked local covariance regression, coefficient averaging, residual correction
candidates.BR4: directional green and R/B masked Laplacian regression, coefficient averaging, residual correction

provenance.implementation: project-authored Rust; mathematical structure from cited analysis; no upstream software imported
provenance.raw_domain_adaptations: float64, epsilon 1e-6, no clipping, measured-site preservation, parity-preserving reflection, explicitly masked fits

freeze.policy: Both candidates fixed before any quality results; no tuning after validation
freeze.pre_measurement_correction: test CFA array type corrected; compilation rejected the first attempt before any quality measurement

decision.reason: Both fail development chromatic/detail/noise gates and new validation achromatic/chromatic/detail gates; development chroma gains do not generalize.

verification.qualification_note: Research-only modules changed; retained installed bundle has the previous DR6/wb3 qualification.

limits: Analytic remosaics are not calibrated Nikon captures or independent photographic ground truth.
No new D850 or other camera/subtype compatibility qualification; point 6 remains deferred.
Full-frame laboratory buffers are not a product memory plan; no timing/RSS performance gate measured.
No denoise, highlight reconstruction or measured camera-profile accuracy inferred.
Uncalibrated captures cannot establish absolute color fidelity.
Published category/phase gates and worst individual scene diagnostics are both retained; large ratios can reflect low baseline error.
